_note: Rules used by engine/rotation_builder.py. Soft-rule weights and suitability_weight are initial placeholders for the team to tune.

rules.description: Crop windows in a 12-month rotation must not overlap. One shared transition month is allowed where a crop's harvest month is the next crop's sowing month (calendars are monthly).
Leave at least one month between consecutive crops for harvest and land preparation.
Every crop in the rotation must have a suitability score of at least 40 in its window.
Include a legume in the rotation.
No two consecutive crops from the same botanical family.
A cereal is followed by a non-cereal.

Where the climate supports two seasons (a regional pack exists, or two non-overlapping windows with score >= 60), prefer a crop in both the cool and the warm season; fallow of 4 or more consecutive months is penalised.
